guidance.statement: 8-10% volume growth band maintains as good growth in current demand context
guidance.quote: anything in the volume, in the current context, which is between that 8% - 10% is a good growth

guidance.statement: PBDIT margins to remain in 18-20% band going forward
guidance.quote: we would keep the guidance between that 18 and 20% band as we go ahead

guidance.statement: 4-5% volume-value gap to persist as structural reality of market
guidance.quote: this 4%-5% is a more realistic thing which would remain in the market

guidance.statement: 5-6% value growth realistic given 8-10% volume with 4-5% gap persistence
guidance.quote: I think that is a reasonable take in terms of what we can look at

guidance.statement: Maintain growth momentum into Q4 with same band continuing
guidance.quote: we want to really maintain the growth momentum

guidance.statement: Industrial and B2B to grow higher than retail with strong traction
guidance.quote: this is something which will really grow, and I think there would be a strong traction which will come in

guidance.statement: All international units except Bangladesh to maintain growth momentum
guidance.quote: with the exception of Bangladesh, I think all other countries should do well overall

guidance.statement: Target 10 lakh people training in FY26, up from 6.7 lakh in 9M
guidance.quote: this year, as we kind of go ahead, we are gunning for training almost 10 lakh people
